rules.instruction: When the description states that two or more actions occur at the same time, or that one action is independent of another after a shared prerequisite: Model the actions on separate branches from a parallel gateway. rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning

rules.instruction: When the description specifies successive activities or a transition into or out of a decision or synchronization point: Connect the corresponding flow nodes with sequence flows so the modeled paths preserve the described order and branch continuation.
